title: LeoLabs Teams with SciTec to Support U.S. Space Force Ground-Based Radar Digitization Program
summary: LeoLabs, Inc. (LeoLabs), the leading provider of persistent Orbital Intelligence, today announced it is teaming with SciTec, a Firefly Aerospace company, to support its recently awarded $93,704,410 firm-fixed price other transaction agreement for ground-based radar digitization. This contract provides for modernization efforts to create a common architecture and design for the upgrade of ground-based radars. Space Systems Command, Colorado Springs, Colorado, is the contracting activity.
